description: Source code implementation of xxHash, a fast hash algorithm, including functions for 32-bit and 64-bit hashing, memory access optimizations, and hash state management.

methods.name: XXH32
methods.description: Computes 32-bit hash of input data with seed.

methods.name: XXH64
methods.description: Computes 64-bit hash of input data with seed.

methods.name: XXH32_createState
methods.description: Creates a new state object for 32-bit hash streaming.

methods.name: XXH64_createState
methods.description: Creates a new state object for 64-bit hash streaming.

methods.name: XXH32_update
methods.description: Updates 32-bit hash state with input data.

methods.name: XXH64_update
methods.description: Updates 64-bit hash state with input data.

methods.name: XXH32_digest
methods.description: Finalizes and returns 32-bit hash value from state.

methods.name: XXH64_digest
methods.description: Finalizes and returns 64-bit hash value from state.

methods.name: XXH32_canonicalFromHash
methods.description: Converts hash to canonical big-endian format.

methods.name: XXH64_canonicalFromHash
methods.description: Converts hash to canonical big-endian format.

methods.name: XXH32_hashFromCanonical
methods.description: Converts canonical format back to hash value.

methods.name: XXH64_hashFromCanonical
methods.description: Converts canonical format back to hash value.

methods.name: XXH_versionNumber
methods.description: Returns the version number of xxHash library.
